meta.title: Meet Irbis: Get started opens Language; the chip shows EN and switches the language
meta.requirement: AC2 — Onb1 buttons and language chip
precondition: First run (reset link), app language English, guest
steps: Tap the chip, choose Русский in the sheet
expected: Chip text is EN; texts "Get started" and "I already have an account" are on screen — UI tree + screenshot
After picking Русский the chip text is RU and "Начать" shows without reopening the screen (≤ 2 s) — UI tree + screenshot
After picking English the chip is EN again, "Get started" returns — UI tree
Get started → onboarding.language is shown; event onboarding_step {step: language} — UI tree + QA events

done: First run (reset link), app language English, guest
